name: Rochor
summary: DTL interchange edge of the Little India / Bugis belt — mall adjacency, mixed condo stock, and city-fringe hops with tourist spillover as the daily tax.
body: Rochor is the shortlist when Downtown Line interchange access and a position between Little India food and Bugis retail matter. Housing is mostly condo and serviced-apartment edges rather than quiet HDB heartland; weekend tourist and mall crowds are real. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops and lifestyle density, not cul-de-sac calm. Compare with Little India for deeper cultural-belt texture, Jalan Besar for late-kitchen energy with slightly less interchange crush, and Bugis when you want the full retail hub and accept heavier footfall.
bestFor: DTL workers who want Little India and Bugis in walking range
households okay with weekend tourist energy
renters comparing serviced vs proper TA nearby
condo tenants who will vet MA move-in lift rules before keys
watchOuts: Facility brochure vs MA booking reality in older condos
housingMix: Condo and serviced-apartment stock with limited quiet HDB texture.
commuteNotes: Downtown Line at Rochor; test Saturday afternoon station exits before you romanticise the interchange.
